knowledge.name: Small business credit policy
knowledge.description: What an application needs, and what happens when documents are missing.

documents.name: application-documents.md
documents.text:
# Application documents

## Required documents
A small business loan application needs the last two years of business tax returns, the last three months of business bank statements, and a personal guarantee signed by every owner of 20% or more.

## Missing documents
An application waiting on documents is paused and the applicant is reminded after 7 days. An application still missing documents after 30 days is withdrawn, and the applicant may apply again.

## Renewals
A line of credit is reviewed for renewal 60 days before it ends.
